en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-170 According to the same documentation, on the authority of Ali ibn Al-Husayn (a.s.), “

(The Blessed Lady) Fatima (a.s.) made an offering for both Al-Hassan (a.s.) and Al-Husayn (a.s.) (when they were born) and sent a leg of lamb along with one Dinar for the midwife when each one was born.”
